title: A Culturally-Rich Romanian NLP Dataset from "Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?" Videos
findings: Religion was one of the topic categories where models generally achieved higher accuracy. A performance gradient was observed, with topics like Science, Religion, and Medicine yielding higher accuracies compared to topics like Literature, Music, and General Culture.
